items.title: Archie Martin Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: And we had another great drummer. He used to play for the Palace. That was Chani.

ctx.x: What would they do? I've never seen them in person, I just have their records.

They used to sing blues, dance, crack jokes. They used to play on the Palace Show, which was the lyrics at that time. And they played several other places. They used to have these tent shows come here. Right back there where the Flint and Bridges Hospital is, they used to have tent shows come across in there. And they used to play on them all in tent shoes. And we had another great drummer. He used to play for the Palace. That was Chani.
